title: How many labelers do you have? A closer look at gold-standard labels
abstract: arXiv:2206.12041v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The construction of most supervised learning datasets revolves around collecting multiple labels for each instance, then aggregating the labels to form a type of "true" label. We question the wisdom of this pipeline by developing a (stylized) theoretical model of this process and analyzing its statistical consequences, showing how access to non-aggregated label information can make training well-calibrated models more feasible than it is with cleaned labels. The entire story, however, is subtle, and the contrasts between aggregated and fuller label information depend on the particulars of the problem, where estimators that use aggregated information exhibit robust but slower rates of convergence, while estimators that can effectively leverage all labels converge more quickly if they have fidelity to (or can learn) the true labeling process. translated_title: 你有多少标注者？深入审视金标准标签
translated_abstract: arXiv:2206.12041v3 公告类型： replace-cross 摘要：大多数监督学习数据集的构建流程是围绕为每个实例收集多个标签，然后将这些标签聚合以形成一种“真实”标签。我们通过为这一过程开发一个（风格化的）理论模型并分析其统计后果，来质疑这一流程的合理性，展示了获取未聚合的标签信息如何使训练校准良好的模型比使用清洗后的标签更加可行。然而，整个情况是微妙的，聚合标签信息与更完整标签信息之间的对比取决于问题的具体细节：使用聚合信息的估计器表现出稳健但较慢的收敛速度，而能够有效利用所有标签的估计器如果对真实标注过程具有保真度（或能够学习该过程），则收敛得更快。该理论对现实世界数据集做出了若干预测，包括何时未聚合的……
tldr: 该论文通过建立理论模型质疑监督学习中聚合多标注者标签的传统流程，证明利用未聚合的原始标签信息比使用清洗后的“金标准”标签更有利于训练校准良好的模型。
en_tdlr: By developing a stylized theoretical model of the label aggregation pipeline, this paper shows that leveraging non-aggregated label information can make training well-calibrated models more feasible than relying on aggregated gold-standard labels.
